MEASUREMENT

GETTING STARTED

What to bring.

Your current website, brand assets, content priorities, required integrations and examples of the experiences you like.

SERVICE QUESTIONS

Before we begin.

Can you redesign our existing website?+

Yes. We review the content, structure and integrations to understand what should be retained and what needs to change.

Are hosting and maintenance included?+

Hosting, domain management, ongoing updates and maintenance are identified separately in the proposal so ownership and responsibilities are clear.

Will the site work on mobile?+

Responsive layouts and cross-device checks are part of the agreed website scope. The pages, devices and browser coverage are identified before launch.

Who supplies the content?+

We agree which copy, images, legal text and business details you will provide and which production tasks are included.
